0022600191.text: The Knicks (4-4, 3rd in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back, 7th in the East) head into this road game against the Cleveland Cavaliers (4-4, 2nd in the Central, 2 games back, 6th in the East) riding a two-game winning streak, while Cleveland has lost its last two. New York is 1-2 on the road and Cleveland is 3-1 at home, and Josh Hart is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision, while Jaylon Tyson is out with an ankle sprain. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 regular-season series 2-1 and won the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, most recently a 130-93 playoff win in Cleveland on May 25, 2026.
